claim.text: The public Pierre Auger SD1500 vertical sample contains a first-harmonic right-ascension residual across the frozen energy-threshold family.

gates.evidence: Official release archive and extracted CSV SHA-256 digests pinned.
Population, five thresholds, statistic, seed, null and decision rule frozen before aggregate inspection.
Uniform-RA null with observed event counts and threshold nesting.
Uniform control returned zero and injected RA=0 direction was recovered.
RA scrambling preserves observed declination/energy acceptance structure for the scoped harmonic.
Dedicated sidereal-time, weather and exposure-stability attacks not yet executed.
Five-threshold family corrected with global nested-null probability and Bonferroni check.
Known statistical variation and established cosmic-ray anisotropy context retained.
Separate official IceCube track produced a compatible null under another instrument.
No independent team reproduction of this exact computation.

integrity_boundary: SHA-256 integrity only; creator identity is not cryptographically signed
limitations: Public 10 percent sample and first harmonic in RA only.
